content.summary: Hospitality operations supervisor with 7 years of experience coordinating guest services, reservations, and frontline teams for boutique tourism properties in Zanzibar. Known for calm service recovery and practical staff development.

experience.title: Guest Services Supervisor
bullets: Managed a 12-person guest-services rota for a 42-room lodge, raising quarterly guest satisfaction from 4.3 to 4.7 out of 5.
Coordinated airport transfers and excursion schedules for 1,800 annual guests, reducing same-day booking errors by 31%.
Trained 9 new team members on service-recovery standards, improving resolution of guest issues within 30 minutes.

experience.title: Reservations Officer
bullets: Processed 3,200 annual reservations across 5 partner properties, maintaining a 98% confirmation accuracy rate.
Created bilingual guest-arrival briefs for 40 weekly bookings, reducing check-in clarification calls by 25%.

education.institution: Zanzibar Institute of Tourism and Development

certifications.name: First Aid and Guest Safety — demonstration

volunteering.description: Coordinated 25 volunteers for quarterly shoreline collection events.
